source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
As a phase ends, if this model was **destroyed** in it for the first time in that battle round, roll a D6. On a 2+, return it to the battlefield:

- with 3 wounds left
- as near as it can be to the spot where it fell
- outside [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of every enemy unit

It can come back this way only once per battle.

trigger.occurrence: first time in a battle round

setBackUp.placement: as close as possible to where destroyed, not within Engagement Range of enemy units
